subject: Labour leader Keir Starmer, apparently swearing at staff
called_fake_by: Labour sources and Conservative MPs, including Simon Clarke and Tom Tugendhat
claim: On the first day of Labour's conference, an anonymous account posted audio of a voice like Starmer's verbally abusing a staffer. Politicians from both major parties warned it was fake.
finding: Full Fact found no evidence the clip was genuine. It was widely reported as an AI fake, alongside a second clip of him supposedly saying he hated Liverpool.
outcome: X declined to remove it, citing a lack of proof it was fake. Starmer became prime minister in July 2024. The Liverpool clip keeps resurfacing.

sources.title: No evidence that audio clip of Keir Starmer supposedly swearing at his staff is genuine
UK opposition leader targeted by AI-generated fake audio smear
